mechanism: Follow one original clearly adult subject through at least four ordinary route chapters with stable clothing, carried-object or gait anchors. Maintain deliberate but bounded observer imperfections—slightly late pans, short foreground occlusions, modest focus recovery and breathing-scale sway—while always returning to the subject and route. The subject must avoid direct camera acknowledgment until the final chapter. End with one unmistakable eye-line change and short approach that reveals awareness of the recorder. The reusable mechanism is ordinary route continuity, controlled observer imperfection, delayed acknowledgment and camera-discovery closure—not the source man, apartment, market, fruit, cat, rooftop, exact framing, creator identity or timing.

invariants.rule: Lock one clearly adult original subject with at least three clothing, object or gait anchors across four ordinary chapters.
invariants.ablation_failure: Unanchored chapter changes suggest different people or days.

invariants.rule: Use only bounded observer imperfections and always recover the subject and route.
invariants.purpose: Creates authentic home-video presence without losing readability.
invariants.ablation_failure: Continuous random shake or focus loss becomes unusable footage.

invariants.rule: Carry one object, direction or completed action from each chapter into the next.
invariants.purpose: Links small events into a day.
invariants.ablation_failure: Independent activities form a loose montage.

invariants.rule: Do not let the subject directly acknowledge the camera before the final chapter.
invariants.purpose: Preserves the observer relationship and delayed reveal.
invariants.ablation_failure: Early eye contact removes the ending's meaning.

invariants.rule: End with one clear eye-line change and short approach toward the lens.
invariants.ablation_failure: A generic wave or cut cannot prove the subject noticed recording.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.
